what: Plan item C4: behaviour directions on the largest model both tools run here, Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (hybrid: 8 full-attention and 24 linear-attention layers, 4,659,865,088 parameters, vocabulary 248,320), both tools in bfloat16 on the Apple GPU (mps), one prompt at a time, 64 + 64 measured prompts, 32 per score, 30 new tokens, 4 trials

second_environment.why: row_normalization full cannot run on mps under torch 2.14.1: torch.svd_lowrank takes 12.5 s a call at [896, 896] and did not return within 170 s at this model's shapes; the same packages with torch 2.15.0, Heretic's source unchanged

settings_of_both_tools.HF_DEACTIVATE_ASYNC_LOAD: 1 (a threaded load ended Heretic's process with a segmentation fault in torch's mps copy kernel)
settings_of_both_tools.LOAD_GIB_PER_S: 1.5 with scripts/load_pacing on PYTHONPATH (the guard ends a run that grows by more than 4 GiB between two samples; unpaced, the weights reach the GPU in about two seconds)

memory_guard: python -m wsp.memory_guard with its default limits for every model process (reservation 16 GiB); no limit was changed; model-free checks under a footprint cap of 8 GiB
bounds: written before the runs in docs/DIRECTIONS.md and the scripts' docstrings; a stage outside its bound is reported as failed and no bound was moved. Two checks had their scope corrected after their first use on a GPU run (bit equality of the ARA fit, and the replica of Heretic's randomized approximation, are asserted on the device Heretic computed on)
